feature_regressions: Valid, expired, and revoked saved sessions can be replaced without logout.
Positional and stdin token sources can replace a different saved identity.
Malformed success, HTTP 503, and dropped connection preserve the previous session.
Pending replacement attempts survive logout and different-token login attempts.
Recovery reuses the original idempotency key and request body.
Replacement session files retain private Unix permissions and tokens are not printed.
